messages: Support check failed: the claim in the 'Why It Matters' section that disgorgement, if deemed a penalty, would be subject to a five‑year statute of limitations is not supported by the supplied evidence (evidence at page 56 actually states the government could bring actions more than five years after the conduct).
Overstatement check failed: the same claim overstates the legal effect of the five‑year limitation contrary to the evidence provided.
